reply.text:
Absolutely — I can help with that in a calm, simple way.

If you want, I can make you a Mediterranean-style grocery list for two that keeps things easy and low-effort for a burnout week. I can base it around a few flexible meals, like:
- a traybake or sheet-pan dinner
- pasta or grains with veg and feta
- hummus/pitta-style lunches
- something cosy for a couple of easy dinners

If you’d like, send me:
- how many dinners you want to cover
- whether you want breakfasts/lunches too
- anything you already have in the cupboard/fridge
- any foods you want to use up or avoid

Then I’ll turn it into a simple shopping list for two with no fuss.
